problemLine: After 30 you lose muscle every decade you don't train it — and that's what makes stairs, shopping bags and getting up off the floor feel harder.
pointABody: Walking keeps your heart healthy. Only lifting tells your body to keep its muscle.
pointBBody: Stand up from a chair as many times as you can in 30 seconds. Re-test every 12 weeks.
statLabel: LOWER RISK OF EARLY DEATH WITH 30–60 MIN A WEEK OF STRENGTH TRAINING
ctaSub: Strength coaching for 35+, in person & online.
